contract_constraints.description: id is integer (uint64) or UUID string; vector is array of floats or object of named vectors; payload is key-value object
contract_constraints.assertion: id type is integer (uint64) or UUID string; vector type is array of floats or object of named vectors; payload type is key-value object.

contract_constraints.description: Overwrite replaces entire payload, not merged
contract_constraints.assertion: PUT payload replaces the entire payload; it does not merge.

contract_constraints.description: limit default=10 (adjustable)
hnsw_ef applicable when exact=false
contract_constraints.assertion: hnsw_ef parameter is applicable only when exact=false.

contract_constraints.description: group_size >= 1; limit >= 1
limit default=10
strategy must be one of: average_vector, best_score, sum_scores
Atomic batch upsert - all points inserted or none
contract_constraints.assertion: Batch upsert is atomic: all points are inserted or none.

contract_constraints.description: Deletion is atomic for the matched set
contract_constraints.assertion: Point deletion is atomic for the matched set.

contract_constraints.description: Atomic - all matched points get the payload
contract_constraints.assertion: Payload set is atomic: all matched points receive the payload.

contract_constraints.description: Batch operations are NOT promised to be atomic; on error, operations may be none, partially, or fully applied; writes are idempotent and clients should retry
contract_constraints.assertion: Batch update operations may be partially applied on failure; atomicity is not guaranteed; clients must retry to reach a consistent state

contract_constraints.description: exact=true performs full scan; exact=false uses segment statistics
contract_constraints.assertion: exact=true performs a full scan; exact=false uses segment statistics.

contract_constraints.description: If exact=true, performs brute-force search (slow but accurate); if exact=false, uses HNSW for approximate search
contract_constraints.assertion: When exact=true, search uses brute-force; when exact=false, search uses HNSW.

contract_constraints.description: prefetch queries execute first, then final query runs on combined results
contract_constraints.assertion: prefetch queries execute first, then the final query runs on combined results.
